verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents automatic reminders and payment retries for overdue or failed invoices, configurable email reminders, and Branding settings for emails and hosted invoices. That covers the automated, branded email part of a dunning sequence. Moving an unpaid invoice to void/uncollectible is only described as an optional status change, not a configurable automated final-state rule. missing for 10: in-app banners, configurable grace periods, automated final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), detail on sequence configuration depth, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: If the invoice becomes overdue, or payment on the invoice fails, Stripe can automatically send reminders or retry the payment for you.
You can configure Stripe to send email notifications or reminders to your customer
Stripe allows you to customize (as well as preview) email receipts, hosted invoices, invoice PDFs, and so on, in your Branding settings.
Optionally, you can change the status of an unpaid invoice to `void` or `uncollectible`.
